best_parts: node q10: gas-free film asks which organism is grown from infected bile, reversing the usual gas-organism stem; Clostridium is a plausible trap, a new form of TR18
node q5: PYQ key versus current practice stated as a pairing, so the teach-both repair (TR11) is tested in exam form
node q11: three options with two traps (two structures seen; bleeding first) and the key 'confirm the view before any clip', mapping cleanly to TR19 and TR20
flaws: nodes q1_ok, q2_ok, q3_ok ... q12_ok (every correct probe): the key is the second option in all 12 probes and the help option is always third. A learner can tap the middle button and pass; this is telegraphing by position (DP1) and it caps R2 and R9.

node q7: 'cystic duct holds an impacted stone and the common hepatic duct is narrowed' replays the S7 Mirizzi vignette almost verbatim, so it tests recall of a stem seen before, not the wrong model. Replay penalty applied.

start: the recap says 'twelve mixed stems, none seen earlier in this module', which is untrue for the Mirizzi, Bouveret, Charcot and organism items (q7 to q10 re-run S7 content). The recap misstates the replay.

best_parts: node p4: renal-colic CT showing silent gallstones; a fresh context for the silent-stone trap, with cholecystectomy, UDCA and expectant management each mapped to one trap
node p6: septic patient on the ward with a tender, distended gallbladder and no stone; early surgery and interval surgery are both tempting and the drain-first key is well framed
node p5: critical-view probe where the correct option is first and the two traps each name half of the view (two structures seen; cystic duct alone)
flaws: node p2: jaundiced patient with gallstones and a dilated CBD who wants the duct seen without a procedure is near-verbatim the S4 TR3 vignette, so it replays earlier content. Replay penalty applied.

node p3: 'Grade I, since the count is above the 50,000 bleeding line' is a filler that no examinee holds as a TG18 model, and the correct grade is the only option whose cut-off matches a number in the stem, so the key is partly findable.
node p1_t1: after a miss the only route is retry; there is no second explanation or show-answer node, so a learner who misses twice is looped back to the probe without the answer.

best_parts: node p12: one mixed item pairs Bouveret, gallstone ileus and Mirizzi by site, so the cold re-test is genuinely mixed as S8 intends
node p9: day-two green drain as a clinical moment; the bile-duct-as-cystic-duct key sits against a vascular trap and a hepatic artery trap, each one wrong model
node p1 with p1_show: a new TG18 organ-criterion form (PaO2/FiO2 against the everyday PaO2 cut-off), with a show-the-answer route after a miss
flaws: node p7: 'Which sign is NOT part of Reynolds' pentad?' has traps that are in the pentad, and p7_t0 says 'Hypotension is not in the triad', which does not answer the NOT stem. The feedback is mismatched to the stem (R2 and R6 precision).

node p3: 'Forget the first test you order. Which is most sensitive and specific?' replays the S4 TR2 recognition item almost verbatim, so it tests recall of an earlier answer rather than the ultrasound-versus-HIDA model. Replay penalty applied.
node p1 (entry): no skip-if-correct fast lane, though the blueprint asks for one; a fit learner must take all twelve probes.
